title: Exact percentage
description: A decimal string PERCENT on the 0-100 scale, so 4.2 means +4.2%. The scale is part of the name: fields on the 0-1 scale must be called …_fraction or …_ratio instead (common/ratio.json). Mixed-scale incidents this rule exists to prevent: db/schema/pg-schema.sql assets.share_pct is written as usd/total*100 (0-100) while apps/web/src/features/market/ticker/client.ts VenueQuote.change24h is a fraction (0-1) and TickerRow.spread is a percent (0-100). All three are JavaScript numbers, so only the name carries the unit.
